column18: Sparse CNN architecture search guided by redundancy (LTH-inspired): 2x-12x smaller models, 2x-19x fewer MACs, under 1% accuracy drop
Accelerated IMP cuts per-iteration training epochs by over 50% at high sparsity while final pruned network matches existing IMP performance
Hybrid SNN-ANN Spike-FlowNet beats its ANN counterpart on optical flow with significant computational efficiency claimed; no figures
SNN-as-RNN for VAD: low-activity training and pruning remove 85% of connections without loss; power claimed well below other methods
Spiking-YOLO on a neuromorphic chip: ~280x less energy than Tiny YOLO, up to 98% of its accuracy, 2.3-4x faster convergence
SpinalFlow at 4-bit, 90% sparsity: 1.8x less energy than 4-bit Eyeriss; 5x less energy, 5.4x less time than 8-bit Eyeriss
Stabilized LTH on Transformer (WMT14) matches magnitude pruning up to 85% sparsity; new combined technique better at higher sparsity
Fixed random base network with per-task supermasks learns 2500 tasks without forgetting; masks stored in minimal memory; no energy metrics
T2FSNN time-to-first-spike coding cuts inference latency to 22% and spikes to under 1% of burst coding on CIFAR-100
Keras-trained network translated to Loihi: 9.5-12.9 images/s, accuracy 79.7-94.0%, 0.6 W cores, 14.9-63.2 mJ/image; no ANN baseline
SNN on raw LiDAR pulses claims remarkable time and power efficiency at comparable accuracy to state-of-the-art methods; no figures
Matching subnetworks found in pre-trained BERT at 40% to 90% sparsity at pre-trained initialization; MLM-task subnetworks transfer universally
LTH-inspired pruned sparse subnets for TCM tongue-inspection domain adaptation; fewer samples and parameters, less power and memory claimed without figures
Tianjic chip: unfolded mapping gives significantly higher throughput and power efficiency than GPUs; semi-folded saves 30x resources
Residual connections, stochastic softmax, hybridization give near state-of-the-art SNN accuracy; large efficiency gains over ANN counterparts, no figures
Spike-count neuron pruning: 400 of 800 neurons removed gives 2.3x less memory, 2.8x better energy efficiency, 1.69% accuracy loss
STDP, conversion, backprop: VGG16-SNN 69.96% on ImageNet; backprop cuts latency up to 8x vs converted SNNs; no ANN comparison
LTH-based structured trimming of deep MIR models removes up to 90% of parameters without accuracy loss; CPU and embedded targets
Adaptive weight pruning cuts SOPs 30% in training and 55% in inference with 0.44% accuracy loss on MNIST (800 neurons)
STDP-trained SNN with periodic weight quantization: 4-bit weights cost 0.09% accuracy (0.28% in behavioral simulation); no ANN comparison
BERT with structured and magnitude pruning: comparable subnetworks exist, even the worst structured ones stay trainable
Continuous Sparsification (l0 approximation) beats pruning and ticket-search baselines on VGG/CIFAR-10 and ResNet-50/ImageNet; fast parallel ticket search
Single-spike SNN on VC707 FPGA: 96% MNIST, 2.8 us latency, 1.13 uJ/classification; sparse connections cut weight memory up to 75%
Digital SNN hardware: 4.5 pJ/SOP, up to 81.5% less energy; MNIST 89.6% at 73.6% output-layer weight sparsity
Reconfigurable FPGA accelerator for CNN and hybrid CNN-SNN designs; 7x faster frame rate than current FPGA accelerators; no SNN-ANN comparison
